title: Hybridization Capture Using RAD Probes (hyRAD), a New Tool for Performing Genomic Analyses on Collection Specimens
boundary: Double-digest RAD fragments are size-selected, stripped of adapters and biotinylated as DNA baits to enrich separate shotgun libraries. Unlike registered Rapture, this is an endogenous probe-factory/shotgun capture route, not locus capture from preformed indexed RAD libraries using a designed bait panel. Specimens and capture-panel substitutions stay one method.
evidence_scope: Published21March2016 primaryPLOS abstract/Fig1 workflow and Results pipeline opening inspected; primaryPubMed26999359 identity/abstract also read (two originals). Original main representations PLOS/PMC are one work. Local Rapture note used only for existing boundary screen, not authority for hyRAD. Full Methods/oligos/SI/corrections/revision and linkedGitHub protocol remain unreviewed. No source bundle/registration or collection.

title: Enhancer hubs and loop collisions identified from single-allele topologies
boundary: Preserves long proximity-ligated concatemers through viewpoint inverse PCR and physical removal of shorter amplicons for long-molecule readout. Differs from registered4C secondary-fragment shortening and paired short-junction recovery; not admitted merely for changing a sequencer or using a different contact-analysis program.
evidence_scope: Published9July2018 primaryNature title/abstract and author-mirrored original Results opening/Fig1 workflow indexed overview read; primaryPubMed29988121 identity inspected. Supporting same-method NatureProtocols10.1038/s41596-019-0242-7 abstract/overview explicitly contrasts long concatemer preservation with original4C. Three originals at overview scope, not whole chemistry review. Direct mainNature open failedidentity redirect; no bypass. Full SI/primer/Cas9 depletion/version/correction scope deferred. title: HiCuT: An efficient and low input method to identify protein-directed chromatin interactions
boundary: In-situ contact formation precedes antibody-directed chromatin tagmentation and amplification, omitting the standard biotin junction pulldown. This target-directed selection/library-installation route differs from bulk Hi-C, HiChIP immunoprecipitation and untargeted Spatial-ATAC-Hi-C tagmentation; lower input, antibody choices and loop calling are not additional protocols.
evidence_scope: One published original (23March2022 PLOS Genetics): abstract, Fig1 workflow overview, discussion selection comparison and chromatin-cleavage/tagmentation opening inspected. PMC8979432 indexed representation is same work. Full recipe/S4 oligos/SI/historical vendor sources/correction/version audit unreviewed. No source bundle/registration/collection.

title: Multi-feature clustering of CTCF binding creates robustness for loop extrusion blocking and Topologically Associating Domain boundaries
boundary: CRISPR-Cas9 selection of viewpoint-containing3C molecules followed by biotin-T7 promoter annealing/extension, enrichment, IVT and native RNA sequencing. This DNA-to-RNA linear amplification/capture route differs from MC-4C viewpoint inversePCR and genericPore-C ligated-DNA readout; not a viewpoint-count or software variant.
